audit.whatIsWrong: diff said FAV while diffRating said 8.5/10, tone was the red used for hard lanes, and report[14] called it a hard matchup.
audit.why: Tryndamere wins 52.33% over 2874 games and the mirror rates the lane HARD from Lucian's side at 40%. Favoured is right; the rating, tone and prose were the leftovers.
audit.corrected: diffRating 4/10, tone set to the favoured green, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lucian five of seven rows including 2+ items, against a 52.33% win rate, and four rows disagreed with their own whys.
audit.why: The mirror settled it as Skill / Lucian / Lucian / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere. He is a lane bully whose poke stops paying once Bloodlust is funded, and level 6 is a straight swap: he spends a 110-second Culling into a health bar that will not drop.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 flipped in matched pairs, all ratings rescaled, and whys 2, 3, 4, 5 rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader three times to block Piercing Light with minions.
audit.why: Piercing Light is fired through a target — Riot's own wording. A minion between you is what he targets, and the bolt continues into you. Standing behind minions is the mistake, not the answer; stepping out of the line sideways is. Relentless Pursuit is also 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 at 445 range, and Lightslinger attacks reduce it, so the dash comes back sooner than the raw number suggests.
audit.corrected: Corrected in early, spikes[0], report[5], whys[2], phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger was described as a 'double-tap passive' with no trading consequence.
audit.why: Every ability he casts loads the double-shot, so each trade is ability plus two bullets — the wind-up after a cast is the cue to step out, not the cast itself.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[1].why, whys[1] and early.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Lucian contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spin up fury on the wave. Piercing Light fires through its target, so a minion between you is a conduit and not cover.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Lucian's Relentless Pursuit is down.
edits.after: Every ability he casts loads a Lightslinger double-shot — the trade is ability plus two bullets, never the ability alone.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lucian must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, but his Lightslinger shots cut it down, so the dash returns sooner than the timer says.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Relentless Pursuit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn: Bloodlust heals the poke off, and Piercing Light stays a 500-range spell, so his chip cannot keep pace with your fury.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lucian's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage answers The Culling head-on: he spends a 110-second ultimate into a health bar that refuses to drop, and then Bloodlust puts it back.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker sticks you to him, and his only exit is a 445-unit dash on a 16-second timer at rank 1.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill-based as neither of you commits a hard all-in yet.
edits.after: Level 2 is his: each ability he casts loads a Lightslinger double-shot.

edits.before: Level 3 is even: his Q-E poke rhythm is matched by your minion-blocking and CS discipline.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: Piercing Light fires through a minion, so standing behind one gives no cover.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour Lucian — his Q-E burst and R Culling out-damage you before your item spike.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn to you as Bloodlust heals off chip his 500-range poke cannot replace.

edits.before: Level 6 is even because your R Undying Rage cancels the value of his R Culling burst.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Undying Rage makes a 110-second Culling buy him nothing at all.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, a 445 dash — his Lightslinger shots cut it down, so it returns early. - Piercing Light: 9s at rank 1, 500 range, and it fires through its target. - The Culling: 110s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: Piercing Light fires through its target — a minion in the way carries the bolt to you rather than blocking it.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 445 dash on 16s at rank 1, shortened by every Lightslinger shot he lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His Lightslinger shots cut that 16-second dash timer down fast.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you survive to Bloodlust and punish his 16-second dash.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: Lucian's Piercing Light (Q) and Relentless Pursuit (E) dash let him poke-and-reset your Q Bloodlust stacks; walk up behind minions to deny his Q line and don't let him free-poke.
edits.after: Piercing Light pierces through whatever it targets, so hiding behind a minion feeds him the line; step out of it sideways instead. Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, and that is your window.

edits.before: Early levels are a skill matchup — Lucian's double-tap passive and Piercing Light (Q) let him poke you down, but he's melee-range-punishable if he steps up to CS. Block his Q with minions and farm; don't take unfavourable poke trades before you have sustain.
edits.after: Early levels are his — the Lightslinger double-shot follows every ability, and Piercing Light fires through a target, so a minion between you carries the bolt instead of stopping it. Stand off his line entirely, farm, and wait for Bloodlust to fund the trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are Lucian's window: his Q-E-Q rhythm chunks you and his R Culling can shred your health bar before your own ult is a factor. Respect his burst, hold Spinning Slash (E) to disengage rather than to chase, and wait for your item spike.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 swing to you: Bloodlust heals off a 500-range poke faster than he can re-apply it, and Relentless Pursuit is 16 seconds at rank 1. Hold Spinning Slash for the moment that dash is spent, then run him down and do not let him walk it off.
